scope: Two early listed games from the 2026 baseball/softball and 2025 or 2025–26 other checked seasons. This convenience sample is not season-wide or representative of every format.
limitations: Only baseball and softball had elapsed durations in the checked summaries. Other values are provisional planning allowances, not researched statistical averages.
Official valid end times take precedence. Estimates apply only to timed events without ends; all-day, TBA, and multi-day ranges are preserved.
Travel, warm-ups, pregame duties and postgame duties are excluded. Overtime, extra innings and match formats may change actual finish times.
Cross-country/track allowances represent meet attendance; golf represents one round. Confirm team-specific commitments with coaches.
